# Third-party compiled asset catalogs

Real `Assets.car` files produced by Apple tools, used only as read-only inputs of the
inspect_asset_catalog tests (`crates/native/tests/car_real_catalogs.rs`).

| File | Source | License | CoreUI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| assets_mac.car | bartoszj/acextract, acextractTests/data | MIT (LICENSE-acextract) | 366 |
| assets_ios.car, assets_iphone.car, assets_ipad.car, assets_tv.car, assets_watch.car | bartoszj/acextract, acextractTests/data | MIT (LICENSE-acextract) | 374 |
| OriginalAssets.car | coollazy/AssetsParser, Example/Resources | Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-AssetsParser) | 868 |
